newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Sky City says visitor numbers fall.
newsitem.headline: Sky City says visitor numbers fall.

text.p: Casino operator Sky City said on Thursday that since announcing its 1996 result in September, it had seen some reduction in the average daily number of visitors.

"During the 1996 trading period, we experienced on average between 13,000 and 13,500 visitors per day. Those numbers have since eased back somewhat and we are now experiencing around 12,500 visitors per day," shareholders at the annual meeting were told.

The company also said all of the facilities in the Sky City complex had opened on time and within pre-established budgets. Only the Sky Tower remained to be completed. It was on schedule for completion and a public opening at the end of June 1997.

"It is likely, however, that there will be some increase to the Sky Tower budget, the modifications will increase the capital budget by up to 10 percent against the previous budget of $75 million," the company said.
